Studio Flat, Craven Street, WC2N

Beautiful Studio Flat – Central London

A gorgeous and spacious studio is set in a beautiful Victorian building with high ceilings and plenty of character.

The studio is fully furnished, stylish and comfortable, making it a great home for both short and long stays.

What’s included:

  • All bills included
  • Fully furnished
  • High ceilings and bright living space
  • Free professional cleaning once a month
  • Flexible rental options

Located right in the heart of London, you’re within easy walking distance of Charing Cross, Trafalgar Square and Covent Garden. There are lots of great cafés, restaurants, theatres and shops nearby, with excellent transport links for getting around the city.

A charming studio in a fantastic central location — ready to become your new London home!

Landlords are only able to refuse applicants on this basis where one of the following exceptions applies:

The landlord has confirmed that one of these exceptions applies.
